## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The "b" recension of Taishō No. 1057, a parallel transmission of [智通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%80%9A) Zhìtōng's two-fascicle *Sahasrabhuja* dhāraṇī-sūtra (cf. [KR6j0256](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0256) for the "a" recension). Both recensions are ascribed to Zhìtōng of Zǒngchísì 總持寺 in the Zhēnguān 貞觀 (627–649) period; the divergent textual transmissions are preserved in different Tripiṭaka editions and were collated together by the Taishō editors as 1057a / 1057b.

**Abstract**

Textually the "b" recension is closely parallel to the "a" recension ([KR6j0256](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0256)) but exhibits divergences in mantra-transcription, mudrā-name, and occasional ordering of the central twenty-five mudrā / spell pairs. The two recensions diverge in places where one transmission has preserved an older Sanskrit phonology and the other a Tang revisionist phonology, suggesting that one is an older copy and the other a partly-revised version that travelled separately into the canon. The Korean canonical recension (TK) preserves one of the two as part of K0292; the divergent copy entered through Sòng *kānjīng* 刊經 channels and was kept distinct because the editors could not safely collate them.

For the textual matter and the Structural Division refer to [KR6j0256](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0256); CANWWW does not give a distinct *toc* for the "b" recension.
